info.name: IES Energy Verifiable Credentials (Complete)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for IES Energy Verifiable Credentials with proper JSON-LD contexts hosted on GitHub Pages.

Includes:
- Consumption Profile VC
- Utility Customer VC
- Generation Profile VC
- Storage Profile VC

**Features:**
- Schema creation
- Template creation (for PDF/QR rendering)
- Credential issuance
- Get credential (JSON & PDF)
- Verification
- Revocation

**Context Files:** https://github.com/Anusree-J/vc_context/tree/main/energy

**Tested and Verified:** All credentials successfully issue and verify against the SunbirdRC credential service.

request.description: Generate a DID for the utility company that will issue energy credentials.
Creates the JSON Schema for Consumption Profile Credentials.
Creates the HTML template for rendering Consumption Profile Credential as PDF with QR code.
Issues a Consumption Profile VC for a residential consumer.
Retrieves the issued Consumption Profile Credential as JSON.
Retrieves the issued Consumption Profile Credential as PDF with QR code. Save the response to view the certificate.
Verifies the Consumption Profile Credential.
Revokes the Consumption Profile Credential. After revocation, verification will show revoked status.
Creates the JSON Schema for Utility Customer Credentials.
Creates the HTML template for rendering Utility Customer Credential as PDF with QR code.

body.raw:
{
    "credential": {
        "@context": [
            "https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1",
            "https://anusree-j.github.io/vc_context/energy/utility-customer-context.json"
        ],
        "type": ["VerifiableCredential", "UtilityCustomerCredential"],
        "issuer": "{{issuer_did}}",
        "issuanceDate": "2026-01-18T00:00:00.000Z",
        "expirationDate": "2027-01-18T23:59:59.000Z",
        "credentialSubject": {
            "id": "did:rcw:customer-john-smith",
            "type": "UtilityCustomerCredential",
            "consumerNumber": "CUST-2026-987654321",
            "fullName": "John Smith",
            "maskedIdNumber": "XXXX-XXXX-1234",
            "installationAddress": "123 Green Energy Lane, Solar City",
            "meterNumber": "MET2026123456789",
            "serviceConnectionDate": "2020-06-15"
        }
    },
    "credentialSchemaId": "{{utility_customer_schema_id}}",
    "credentialSchemaVersion": "1.0.0",
    "tags": ["energy", "utility", "customer"]
}

body.raw:
{
    "schema": {
        "type": "https://anusree-j.github.io/vc_context/energy/generation-profile-context.json#GenerationProfileCredential",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "id": "generation-profile-credential-v1",
        "name": "Generation Profile Credential",
        "author": "{{issuer_did}}",
        "authored": "2026-01-18T00:00:00.000Z",
        "schema": {
            "$id": "GenerationProfileCredential-1.0",
            "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema",
            "description": "Generation Profile Credential for renewable energy systems",
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "consumerNumber": { "type": "string", "description": "Prosumer identifier" },
                "fullName": { "type": "string", "description": "Prosumer full name" },
                "generationType": { "type": "string", "description": "Type of generation (Solar PV/Wind/etc.)" },
                "capacityKW": { "type": "string", "description": "Generation capacity in kW" },
                "commissioningDate": { "type": "string", "description": "Date of commissioning" },
                "meterNumber": { "type": "string", "description": "Generation meter number" },
                "assetId": { "type": "string", "description": "Unique asset identifier" },
                "equipmentManufacturer": { "type": "string", "description": "Equipment manufacturer" },
                "equipmentModel": { "type": "string", "description": "Equipment model" }
            },
            "required": ["consumerNumber", "fullName", "generationType"],
            "additionalProperties": true
        }
    },
    "tags": ["energy", "generation", "renewable", "ies"],
    "status": "DRAFT"
}
